title: V4 BU Autopilot Approval
description: Explicit contract between 'Claude proposed' and 'the operator authorized'. No skill may set status=approved/partially_approved on its own — only an explicit operator request does (operation/task-rules.md, operation/replanning-rules.md). Every approved_item is hash-locked to the exact payload it approves (scripts/lib/approval.py); if the source artifact changes afterward, the approval becomes stale and no material ACTION may consume it.

created_at.description: Execution timestamp: when this approval record (candidate or real) was written. Real system clock.

approved_at.description: null while status=draft. Set only when the operator explicitly authorizes — never inferred, never defaulted to created_at.

approved_by.description: 'operator' by default, or an explicit identifier actually available in this execution's context. Never a fabricated person.

artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 of the source artifact's canonical JSON at the moment this approval was created — scripts/lib/artifact_hash.py.

superseded_by.description: approval_id of the approval that replaced this one, when status=superseded.

approved_payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact item payload (e.g. the task_proposal object) being approved.

conditions.description: Any condition the operator attached (e.g. 'somente após confirmar estoque').
